thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-us-central-1-oscura pool GPU saturation 100% for 18m. Single tenant 'oscura-tech' consuming 92% of pool capacity. Request queue growth and 503s observed. Incident ID INC-2026-1782235678. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/incs/INC-1782235678
Maria Chen: ack. jumping in. pulling pool and job list.
Jin Park: I see a spike of hundreds of short-lived inference workers from oscura's webhooks. Possibly a feedback loop.
Aria Singh: paging AM and security, oscura is an enterprise VPC customer, need to be careful with any cross-tenant routing.
Omar Castillo: autoscaler is disabled for this pool due to a recent maintenance window (scheduled last week). That explains why we didn't scale. Checking infra tickets.
Maria Chen: ugh. maintenance flag prevented autoscale. Can we temporarily lift it? Any risk to other tenants?
Omar Castillo: safe to enable but autoscaler needs capacity to be available in region. current cloud quota = 0 spare GPUs in us-central.
Jin Park: quick mitigations: 1) apply emergency per-tenant concurrency cap, 2) throttle webhook fanout at ingress LB, 3) enable model compression fallback (serve quantized variant: gpt-medium-8bit) for oscura, 4) preempt low-priority jobs in the pool.
Maria Chen: I'll try the concurrency cap first.
Maria Chen: ```
redctl tenant update oscura-tech --concurrency 20 --reason "emergency cap"
```
incident-bot: tenant concurrency update applied by Maria Chen.
Aria Singh: messaging sent to account channel and legal looped in. Oscura on call: @oscura-eng has been paged.
Jin Park: listing active tasks on pool:```rctl tasks --pool dedicated-us-central-1-oscura --json | jq '.[] | {task,tenant,priority,workers,gpu_mem}'```
Jin Park: found two large jobs: fine-tune-1402 (priority: low, workers: 64, gpu_mem: 40GB each) and realtime-aggregator (priority: high). fine-tune-1402 is the offender.
Maria Chen: can we evict fine-tune-1402? It's low priority but belongs to same tenant. Evicting will free ~4 GPUs.
Omar Castillo: eviction ok. Doing `rctl task evict --id fine-tune-1402 --force --reason "emergency eviction"`
Jin Park: eviction completed. Pool GPU util dropped to ~78%, queue length dropped. 503s decreased but tail latency still elevated.
Maria Chen: oscura's support replied: the fine-tune was kicked off accidentally by their CI loop after a bad deploy. They can pause CI. Asking them to confirm.
Aria Singh: oscura confirmed pausing CI; they request we avoid migrating their tasks to shared-hosted or cross-tenant nodes (they have strict data residency rules).
Jin Park: since we can't move them to shared pools, next step is local optimizations: enable quantized model serving for their requests to lower memory/GPU load. This will reduce per-request GPU time.
Maria Chen: enabling gpt-medium-8bit fallback for tenant.```route override --tenant oscura-tech --from model:gpt-medium --to model:gpt-medium-8bit --duration 60m --note "emergency to reduce GPU usage"```
incident-bot: route override applied by Maria Chen.
Omar Castillo: interestingly, enabling 8-bit reduced GPU memory footprint and allowed additional concurrency on existing nodes. util back to ~65%.
Jin Park: still want a durable fix: cloud quota increase required or reopen autoscale post-maint maintenance. Maria please open cloud request and mark priority high.
Maria Chen: opened cloud ticket CLD-56789 requesting +6 GPUs in us-central for 2 hours. ETA from cloud team ~1h.
Aria Singh: filing internal RA tickets: RA1 - remove maintenance-blocking autoscale flag and verify behavior (owner: Omar), RA2 - platform guardrail: alert when single tenant >70% for 15m (owner: Maria), RA3 - tenant-side CI safeguard doc for enterprise customers (owner: Aria).
oncall-rota: handoff: next oncall please note: oscura throttled to 20 concurrency, low-priority fine-tune evicted, quantized fallback enabled, cloud quota requested CLD-56789, AM notified.
Jin Park: also adding a wise temporary measure: enable soft preemption where new batch jobs from non-critical tenants get lower scheduler priority in this pool for 30m. This requires confirmation but helps avoid complete starvation.
Maria Chen: cannot preempt across tenants without agreement. keep suspension to same-tenant low-priority jobs only.
Aria Singh: oscura just confirmed they paused CI and saw normal traffic for 10m. They asked for a short postmortem explaining what happened and our mitigation steps.
Maria Chen: creating follow-up INC-FOLL-1782235678 with timeline, customer comms, and owner assignments. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and will resolve incident after stable window.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. Customer impact: oscura-tech experienced ~12m degraded responses and intermittent 503s during spike window. AM notified.
oncall-rota: handoff complete. Next oncall: @Jin Park. Remember to attach console graphs to postmortem.
Jin Park: noted. I'll draft the postmortem and include recommendation: block-unbounded job starts from tenant-side CI by default for dedicated pools, and an opt-in emergency burst pool for enterprise customers with explicit consent.
Maria Chen: thanks team. keeping an eye, will mark resolved after observation window. :white_check_mark:
